visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a POV shot from inside a car moving through a metallic, ribbed tunnel-like structure. A white Volkswagen Golf is directly in front, bearing a Swiss license plate 'VS 59509'. (2) A sharp cut to a medium close-up of a young male with short dark hair wearing a white hoodie; he is inside a car, looking upwards with a wide smile and wide eyes, appearing extremely surprised and excited. (3) The scene shifts to a static long shot at a traffic stop. Two red lights are visible under signs for 'Goppenstein'. A white Mercedes-Benz is stopped in front of the camera, with a background of steep, rocky mountains partially covered in snow and solar panel arrays on the left. (4) A close-up handheld shot shows a hand holding a white 'bls' transport ticket. The ticket displays 'CHF 28.00' and mentions 'Kandersteg' and 'Goppenstein'. (5) A mirror view shot shows the side mirror of the car reflecting two people (a man in a white shirt and a woman in a dark dress) standing outside their vehicle on the roadside, both peeling and eating bananas. (6) Back to the young male in the white hoodie, who is talking directly to the camera with high facial arousal and animated expressions while seated in the car. (7) POV shot from the driver's seat looking at the dashboard and steering wheel as the car slowly drives onto a flatbed train carriage. Other cars are visible lined up in front on the same train. (8) The train begins moving, and the car's speed display on the dashboard fluctuates. The environment is an open-air track with mountains on one side. (9) The train enters a dark, dimly lit tunnel. The POV shot shows the interior of the train's protective metal roof as the car remains stationary on the moving platform.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, excited male voice exclaiming 'Driving on a train!' over a high-tempo, upbeat electronic pop BGM. The voice exhibits a rising pitch contour and high arousal. (2) A transition SFX occurs, followed by the speaker describing the long red light at Goppenstein station with a humorous, energetic tone. The BGM remains consistent with a strong 4/4 beat. (3) A soft paper-handling-like rustle or digital pop accompanies the mention of the 28 Swiss Franc ticket price. The speaker's delivery is rapid and engaging. (4) The speaker laughs slightly as he describes people eating bananas in the rear-view mirror. The background ambience features a low-level car interior hum. (5) A sharp vocal exclamation marks the 'sudden situation' as the car begins boarding the train. The speaker's voice becomes louder and more high-pitched to convey amazement. (6) A shift in the acoustic atmosphere occurs as the car enters a tunnel; the voice gains a slight metallic reverb and the ambient noise floor increases with a low-frequency rumble representing train movement. The BGM continues to drive the rhythm until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share the unique and surprising experience of using a car-carrying train service in Switzerland, highlighting the cost and the novelty of being stationary while moving at high speeds through tunnels.
